verdict.rationale: YYLO is a CLI orchestrator that runs coding agents against a local Git checkout. `task start` creates a dedicated branch and worktree, and `merge land` delivers committed candidates with Git ref protection. It also has a GitHub integration, but that integration only pulls GitHub issues into kanban and returns responses to the source thread; nothing shows an agent connecting to a GitHub repository or opening pull requests against it. Missing for 10: a documented GitHub repo connection or authorization flow, agent-opened pull requests on GitHub, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
